record.question:
Which one of the following is the most important long-term benefit of promoting indigenous technology
    in India?
options: Technological self-reliance and enhanced national competitiveness
Limiting international dependencies during global scientific collaborations
Minimizing immediate fiscal expenditure on foreign equipment and machinery
Decrease in cost of industrial research
